title: When did the first-through-twelfth-grade school with the largest enrollment
question: When did the first-through-twelfth-grade school with the largest enrollment open?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T2.OpenDate
FROM EnrollmentData AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
INNER JOIN SchoolInfo AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T3."Low Grade" = '1'
  AND T3."High Grade" = '12'
ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1
